access_token.description: This is a Bearer token that can be given to you by your admin under `Identity and Access`. This can also be sourced from the `PIPELINES_ACCESS_TOKEN` or `JFROG_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable. Defauult to empty string if not set.

check_license.description: Toggle for pre-flight checking of Artifactory Enterprise license. Default to `true`.

url.description: URL of Artifactory. This can also be sourced from the `PIPELINES_URL` or `JFROG_URL` environment variable. Default to 'http://localhost:8082' if not set.

friendly_name.description: The name of the node. Should be prefixed with the project key

is_on_demand.description: Set to true for dynamic node pool. Set to false for static node pool.

is_swap_enabled.description: Enable/disable the use of swap space to increase the amount of virtual memory available to the node. Not available to Windows node pools.

node_pool_id.description: Id of the node pool where the node will live.

project_id.description: Id of the project where the node will live.

block.description: Provides an JFrog Pipelines Node resource.

architecture.description: Set the architecture. This is currently limited to x86_64.

environments.description: In a project, an array of environment names in which this pipeline source will be.

is_on_demand.description: Set to true for dynamic node pool. Set to false for static node pool.

name.description: The name of the node pool. Should be prefixed with the project key

node_idle_interval_in_mins.description: Number of minutes a node can be idle before it is destroyed.

number_of_nodes.description: Max number of nodes available in the pool.

operating_system.description: Operating systems supported for the selected architecture.

project_id.description: Id of the project where the node pool will live.

block.description: Provides an Jfrog Pipelines Node Pool resource.

environments.description: In a project, an array of environment names in which this pipeline source will be.

is_internal.description: Set this as false to create a Pipelines integration.

master_integration_id.description: The Id of the master integration.

master_integration_name.description: The name of the master integration.

name.description: The name of the project integration. Should be prefixed with the project key

is_sensitive.description: Is the underlying Value sensitive or not

label.description: Key or label of the input property.

block.description: Multiple objects with the values for the integration.

Provides an JFrog Pipelines Project Integration resource.

branch.description: For single branch pipeline sources. Name of branch that has the pipeline definition.

branch_exclude_pattern.description: For multi-branch pipeline sources, a regular expression of the branches to exclude.

branch_include_pattern.description: For multi-branch pipeline sources, a regular expression of the branches to include.

environments.description: In a project, an array of environment names in which this pipeline source will be.

file_filter.description: A regular expression to determine which files to include in pipeline sync (the YML files), with default pipelines.yml. If a templateId was provided, it must be values.yml.

is_multi_branch.description: True if the pipeline source is to be a multi-branch pipeline source. Otherwise, it will be a single-branch pipeline source.

name.description: The name of the pipeline source. Should be prefixed with the project key

project_id.description: Id of the project where the pipeline source will live.

project_integration_id.description: Id of the project Github integration to use to create the pipeline source.

repository_full_name.description: The full name of the Git repository including the user/organization as it appears in a Git clone command. For example, myOrg/myProject.

template_id.description: The id of a template to use for this pipeline source, in which case the fileFilter will only specify the values.yml

block.description: Provides an JFrog Pipelines Source resource.

name.description: The name of the project. Note: this is *not* the project key.
